description:
Replace `ProfilePackageId` with `ProfileId`, so a profile has one identity type constructed only through validation.

## Background

`ProfilePackageId` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/profile_apply.rs:521`) is an unvalidated `String` wrapper. Production code builds it by stringifying a `ProfileId` (`crates/jit/src/profile/apply_claims.rs:83,98`), and it appears in `ProfileTargetConflict`, `ContributionConflictOwner` and profile claims, as well as in `commands/profile.rs`, `output/failure.rs`, `repository_state/initialize.rs` and `repository_state/materialize.rs`. `ProfileId` is the validated identity in `domain::identity`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ProfilePackageId` no longer exists, and every site it occupied holds `ProfileId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: No production code stringifies a `ProfileId` to build another profile identity.
- [hard] REQ-03: Profile conflict output and failure envelopes are unchanged for valid package ids, and `jit --schema` still describes these fields as strings.
title: A profile has one identity type
